set.body:
Objective
Estimate confirmation loadings by regressing held-out brain data on frozen target-derived T = Y C, with nuisance adjustment and admitted error model. Return component-specific and omnibus voxel hypotheses.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements INF-02, PAT-03, NUM-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
statistical implementation; voxel confirmation estimand; small design solves and batched evidence products. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M4.04, M4.01. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Use target-derived confirmation scores, never regress X onto X W and call the resulting association task significance.
2. All voxels share a batched matrix product and small design solve; unpenalized maps/standard errors remain distinct from selected sparse coefficients.
3. Independent analytic t/F/interval fixtures cover nuisance, missing/aliased target dimensions and non-estimability.
4. Tests concern task-linked forward projection, not causal necessity or unique decoding value; supported dependence corrections retain their units.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M4.05: Implement batched unpenalized voxel-loading confirmation
